name: VX Per
description: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that pulsates every 10.89 days; its mean radius is 117 solar radii.

radius.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, VX Per: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 117 +/- 13.8 (Monte-Carlo)

temperature.source: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 251, Name='VX Per', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5375 +/- 208 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic)

gravity.source: Luck (2018), AJ 156, 171, VizieR J/AJ/156/171/table11, recno 39, Name='VX Per', column Gavg ('Average gravity over cycle'; log g in dex, ReadMe unit label cm/s2): log g 1.64 averaged over the pulsation cycle

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 506779550797525760 (quality A), from 2012ApJ...748..107P; Gaia DR3 measures none

distance.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, VX Per: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 4139.4 +/- 483.6 (Monte-Carlo)

color.reason: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.475 +/- 0.011 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation

text.card: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 10.9 days.
text.introduction: Its mean radius, 117 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 4,139 parsecs away.
text.locator: table10, VX Per: Per, Rad, Dist

notes: The star pulsates; it is drawn at its mean radius.
No dynamical mass is measured for this Cepheid; its mass is left unmeasured.
